_comment: The lab-harvester-v1.8.1.json capture expressed in the measurement schema. Same numbers, same read-only origin (kubectl get/describe only); this file exists so validate.js has a real capture to run against, and as the worked example to copy. The original file is kept in its pre-schema shape because benchmark.js reads it directly.
_addonComment: Scored against the add-on configuration the cluster actually ran: neither rancher-monitoring nor rancher-logging was installed, and this is a standalone Harvester rather than one imported into an external Rancher.
_termComment: Per-node terms are stated for the 24-thread node. The kubelet reserve is systemReserved+kubeReserved from the node's own kubelet config (424m+636m); Longhorn is the longhorn-system namespace's summed CPU requests, whose memory requests are genuinely zero. The cluster row is the v1.8.1 lab decomposed by workload kind: every Deployment/StatefulSet across all namespaces, counted once.

terms.detail: instance-manager guaranteed CPU; memory requests are zero
every Deployment/StatefulSet in every namespace, counted once

_vmComment: reqMemGiB is spec.domain.resources.requests.memory (guest / memory overcommit). overheadMiB is the compute container's memory request minus that. vfio counts VMs with any passthrough device, not device count.

vms.name: vm-4
vms.note: 2 VFIO host devices, but only 1 GiB charged - the KubeVirt branch is a boolean

notes: 2 compute nodes + 1 witness; the witness runs no Longhorn instance-manager.
rancher-monitoring and rancher-logging were NOT installed, so the add-on coefficients are not validated by this capture.
